subject: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)
body:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 8:46 AM PST
Subject: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)

Team,

Pulling together the final HubSpot setup needed for PLG signal routing (company properties + workflow triggers + API token). Before I create/update anything in prod, can you confirm the below is aligned with ENG/PM specs?

1) Company properties to add (v1)
- rw_plg_signal_last_seen_at (datetime)
- rw_plg_signal_first_seen_at (datetime)
- rw_plg_signal_type (dropdown) [spend_growth, rate_limit_pain, concurrency_burst, security_intent, residency_intent, contact_sales, pricing_intent]
- rw_plg_signal_score (number)
- rw_plg_signal_window (dropdown) [7d, 14d, 30d]
- rw_plg_signal_trigger_id (single-line text) (idempotency key from writer)
- rw_plg_signal_cooldown_until (datetime)
- rw_plg_signal_suppressed (boolean)
- rw_plg_signal_suppressed_reason (dropdown) [active_opp, enterprise_csm_managed, opt_out, duplicate, other]
- rw_plg_signal_payload_hash (single-line text) (for dedupe/debug)
- rw_plg_signal_debug_url (single-line text) (optional link to internal dashboard)

2) Workflow trigger approach (HubSpot limitation)
HubSpot workflows can’t enroll on “timeline event created” reliably for our use case. Proposed: integration updates a dedicated boolean + timestamp on the company record:
- rw_plg_signal_enroll (boolean) set true by writer
- rw_plg_signal_enroll_at (datetime) set by writer
Workflow enrolls when rw_plg_signal_enroll becomes true AND rw_plg_signal_suppressed is false.
Then workflow action 1: create task, action 2: enroll into SDR sequence (Grace’s team) OR create AE task depending on routing.

3) Token / auth
I’m planning to create a HubSpot Private App (prod) with least-privilege scopes for:
- crm.objects.companies.read/write
- crm.objects.owners.read
- crm.objects.contacts.read (optional; only if we need contact lookup)
- crm.objects.custom.read (if we end up using a custom object later)
- automation (if required for workflow enrollment / sequences)

4) Rollout
- Stage 0: create properties in sandbox (today)
- Stage 1: create same properties in prod (tomorrow AM) but NO workflow active
- Stage 2: turn on workflow with pilot allowlist filter only
- Stage 3: expand routing rules after pilot sign-off (per PM-414)

Attachments:
- rw_hubspot_properties_plg_signals_v1.csv
- rw_hubspot_workflow_spec_plg_signal_trigger_v1.pdf

If you can reply with any changes by EOD, I’ll implement tomorrow and update INT-441 with confirmation + screenshots.

Thanks,
David
—
David Kim
Biz Systems / HubSpot Admin
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 10:12 AM PST
Subject: Re: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)

Looks good overall.

A couple notes from ENG-2843/2842 implementation:
- We can set rw_plg_signal_enroll=true and also immediately set it back to false after write, but HubSpot sometimes misses rapid toggles. Prefer:
  - set rw_plg_signal_enroll=true
  - workflow triggers on “becomes true”
  - workflow clears it back to false (action at end)

- For idempotency/dedupe, we’ll send:
  - rw_plg_signal_trigger_id = sha256(account_id + signal_type + window_end + version)
  - rw_plg_signal_payload_hash = sha256(full payload)

- We do NOT need contact lookup in v1 (no contact creation). Company-only is fine.

Re: scopes — I think we do need whatever HubSpot calls the engagement/task write scope since we’re creating tasks (and optionally logging a note). If you can confirm exact scope names in HubSpot UI, that’d be great.

Also: can you add rw_plg_signal_version (single-line text) so we can distinguish v1 vs later tweaks? Useful for troubleshooting.

Logan

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 10:38 AM PST
Subject: Re: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)

+1 to Logan’s suggestion to have the workflow clear rw_plg_signal_enroll at the end.

Two Sales Ops asks:
1) Ownership/routing
- The workflow should not reassign owners; it should only create tasks and enroll sequences based on current owner + region/segment mapping.
- We’ll manage owner mapping separately (existing rules).

2) Suppression logic
We need the workflow enrollment filter to exclude:
- company has an open deal in stages: “Discovery”, “Evaluation/POC”, “Security Review”, “Procurement”, “Closed Won”
- company property rw_account_type = “Enterprise (CS-managed)” (CS suppression)
- company property rw_plg_opt_out = true

If any of those are true, still write the signal properties (for visibility) but no tasks/sequences.

If you need exact pipeline/stage IDs, I can pull them.

Isabelle
—
Isabelle Laurent
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 11:07 AM PST
Subject: Re: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)

Timeline check:
- If you can stand up properties in prod tomorrow morning (no workflow), ENG can start writing to prod in “dry-run” mode (write signal properties only) behind the pilot flag.
- We’ll plan workflow activation for Monday after we validate:
  - no duplicate company updates (idempotency keys stable)
  - write error rate < 1% over a few thousand events
  - rate limits OK during peak

Could you also add a simple “Last PLG signal write status” field?
- rw_plg_signal_last_write_status (dropdown) [ok, error]
- rw_plg_signal_last_write_error (multi-line text)

This helps support triage without needing engineers to dig logs.

Talia

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 1:56 PM PST
Subject: Re: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)

All — great, incorporated updates.

Changes I’ll make:
- Add rw_plg_signal_version (text)
- Add rw_plg_signal_last_write_status (dropdown: ok/error)
- Add rw_plg_signal_last_write_error (multi-line)
- Workflow clears rw_plg_signal_enroll to false as final step
- Workflow enrollment filters for suppression:
  - rw_plg_signal_suppressed = false
  - rw_plg_opt_out != true
  - rw_account_type != “Enterprise (CS-managed)”
  - AND “no open deal” in active stages (Isabelle: please send exact stage list/IDs when you have them; I can stub with stage names for now)

API token / scopes update:
- HubSpot private app rate limits (per HubSpot docs + admin UI): 100 requests / 10 seconds per app. We’ll be fine if writer batches and uses backoff (ENG-2843 already has this).
- Private app scopes I’ll request:
  - crm.objects.companies.read
  - crm.objects.companies.write
  - crm.objects.owners.read
  - crm.objects.tasks.write (for task creation)
  - crm.objects.notes.write (optional; for “PLG Signal Summary” note — can skip if not needed)

Re sequences: enrolling into sequences via API can require Sales Hub + specific permissions. If we hit friction, we can start with “create task + set task queue” for pilot, and add sequence enrollment in v1.1. Grace — ok to pilot with tasks only if needed?

Next steps
- Today: create properties in sandbox and share screenshots
- Tomorrow 9–10am PT: create properties in prod (no workflow)
- Monday: enable workflow w/ pilot allowlist filter

I’ll update INT-441 with the finalized property list and workflow logic.

David

Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 2:18 PM PST
Subject: Re: HubSpot PLG signals: property + workflow config, API token scopes, and rollout plan (pilot)

Tasks-only is totally fine for pilot.

As long as the task body includes:
- signal type + why it fired (e.g., “429s on /chat/completions 12x in 7d”)
- recommended next step (Dedicated convo vs Security packet)
- link to the company record

We can run sequences manually off tasks for the pilot week.

Grace

SDR Program Owner
Redwood Inference
